title: Save shows a message naming the change
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing one new category made for this test, tier A on Margin % 25 in every range.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Pick Margin % in tier A's rule picker.
  5. Type 28 in tier A's first range.
  6. Click Save.
  7. Open Settings › Categories.
  8. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list after opening Settings › Pricing.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • Tier A's ranges are Margin % and empty.

Step 5:

  • Tier A's ranges show 28 (typed and gray).

Step 6:

  • A message reads matrix A's name followed by "saved", then "1 change:" tier A's name "is 28% margin." and "Parts already on work orders keep their prices."
  • The grid returns to view.
  • Tier A's changed cells are highlighted.

Step 7:

  • The Categories page opens.

Step 8:

  • Matrix A's page opens with no cell highlighted, while the grid shows tier A at 28% margin.
